These are visible copies of the files in the hidden ".github/workflows" folder.
If your file browser hides folders starting with a dot, the workflow still exists at
.github/workflows/build-android.yml inside this project. When uploading to GitHub,
use "git push" (recommended) or create the file in the GitHub web editor via
Add file > Create new file > type ".github/workflows/build-android.yml" and paste the contents.
